Dear Dr. Sarah Davis,

I am writing to refer my patient, Donald Smith (Date of Birth: 01/22/1995), for cardiology evaluation and management.

Donald Smith has been under my care for the past three years. The patient recently presented with complaints of intermittent palpitations and exercise intolerance that have been worsening over the past two months. Resting ECG performed in our office showed occasional premature ventricular contractions. A 24-hour Holter monitor revealed frequent PVCs with short runs of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia.

The patient's medical history includes well-controlled hypertension managed with amlodipine 5 mg daily, and mild hyperlipidemia treated with dietary modification. There is a family history of sudden cardiac death in a first-degree relative.

I would appreciate your evaluation of this patient and any recommendations regarding further workup or treatment. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you require any additional information.
